concept.hr: Klase i kodovi koji su važni: prva znamenka kaže čiji je problem
concept.en: The classes and the codes that matter: the first digit says whose problem

summary.hr: Plakat u pet stupaca, 1xx do 5xx: filtriraj po klasi, klikni kod za primjer zahtjeva i odgovora; 301 vodi na nov zahtjev, 304 ne preuzima ništa.
summary.en: A poster in five columns, 1xx to 5xx: filter by class, click a code for an example request and response; 301 leads to a new request, 304 downloads nothing.
